synthesis: SendEndOfShiftSummary (dispatched from ClarityScoutShiftController::end():143 and CloseInactiveShiftsCommand:91) exhausts 5 retries with a Postgres 57014 while building a closed shift's summary. The whole job body runs inside DB::connection('platform')->transaction(); once a transaction is open on 'platform' all subsequent queries on that connection route to the WRITE host (sticky), matching the ticket's 'platform WRITE connection' claim even for a pure SELECT. The only non-trivial hand-written-SQL platform-connection query is BuildShiftSummary::buildZoneSummaries() (178-193): INNER JOIN public.scans ⋈ platform.zones ON ST_Contains(z.geom, s.geo), filtered by kit_id + scanned_at range + org_id. Raw SQL, not Eloquent Scan::query(), so ScanTimezoneScope is never in play — DEV-2309's withoutGlobalScope fix is structurally inapplicable. Same family, different unfixed instance.

scope.summary: Fence the scans side of buildZoneSummaries's spatial join behind a MATERIALIZED pre-filter CTE so PG cannot drive from zones/geo-GiST across unbounded scans history before applying kit_id+scanned_at. Then decide AC-3 alerting with a human.

proposed_changes.change: Rewrite buildZoneSummaries() raw SQL (178-193) as WITH shift_scans AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, scanned_at, geo FROM public.scans WHERE kit_id=? AND scanned_at BETWEEN ? AND ?) SELECT ... FROM shift_scans s JOIN platform.zones z ON public.ST_Contains(z.geom, s.geo) WHERE z.org_id=? AND z.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.scanned_at, z.id. MATERIALIZED forces the small kit+window set first (kit_id+scanned_at btree) before the spatial predicate.
proposed_changes.reason: Only platform-connection query lacking a plan-safety fence; matches DEV-2220/DEV-1898 'push filtering into the DB'.

proposed_changes.change: AC-3 (pending human): (a) leave failed() as-is (logs + records summary_skipped_reason), (b) relabel 'mail_failed' so a query/build failure isn't mislabeled, and/or (c) add an active Notification on terminal failure modeled on ImportZonesFromKml::failed()->ZoneImportCompleted reusing adminEmails(), or route via spatie/laravel-slack-alerts / commented-out Horizon::routeSlackNotificationsTo.
proposed_changes.reason: AC-3 asks the build session to decide; repo has a live notify-on-terminal-failure precedent (ImportZonesFromKml) that this job does not follow today (log + DB column only).

questions.q: Does DEV-2309's merged fix cover this ticket's timeout?
questions.answer: No. DEV-2309 fixed Eloquent Scan::query() aggregates on 'zod' (latestActivityFor, EnsureOpenShift x2). buildZoneSummaries is raw SQL on 'platform' that never instantiates the Scan model, so ScanTimezoneScope was never in play. Verified via commits 4523ca9b5 / e0bada538 + current source.

questions.q: Should AC-3 add a new proactive alert (Notification to org admins / ops Slack), or is the existing failed() log + summary_skipped_reason column sufficient?
Is 'mail_failed' acceptable for a query-timeout/build-failure, or relabel/split (e.g. 'build_failed' vs 'mail_failed')? Relabel would change the string the existing pinning test asserts.
Does the MATERIALIZED-CTE rewrite eliminate 57014 at prod scale, or is there a different join-order/stat issue (e.g. the scans DEFAULT partition) the query fix alone won't address?

notes: 'zod' and 'platform' = two connection NAMES on the SAME physical Postgres DB (same host/port/database=zod), differing only in search_path ('public' vs 'platform'); 'platform' sticky=true. Once a transaction opens on 'platform', all subsequent queries on it route to the WRITE host — why the timeout shows on the WRITE connection for a pure SELECT.
buildZoneSummaries is schema-qualified raw SQL (public.scans, platform.zones) — works regardless of search_path; not a search_path bug.

public.scans is RANGE-partitioned by scanned_at with a DEFAULT catch-all (new_scans_default). Local vendored dump has explicit monthly partitions only through 2026-04; later dates fall into DEFAULT. If prod's partman maintenance stalled, a bloated DEFAULT partition would independently degrade pruning for ANY date-ranged scans query — worth a DBA check as a 'why now' companion, separate from the code fix (which still helps).
No backoff()/retryUntil(); default no-backoff x5 matches the ~2-min, 5-error prod window — deterministic query-plan failure, not transient contention.
No app-level statement_timeout override in config/database.php — enforced by the server/role GUC.

Test-isolation gap: BuildShiftSummaryTest docblock (17-25) documents the PG⋈zones breakdown is untested because scans (Scan model, 'zod') and the raw-SQL zone join ('platform') are separate PG sessions under RefreshDatabase, so uncommitted writes are mutually invisible even though TestCase connectionsToTransact lists both. New test must seed scans via DB::connection('platform')->table('scans')->insert(...).
buildZoneSummaries counts ALL scans incl hidden (raw SQL bypasses ShowVisibleScan) — pre-existing quirk; PRESERVE exactly (no is_visible filter) to avoid an unrequested scope change.
Kit::query() in forShift/resolveDriver runs on 'zod', not 'platform' — not everything inside the platform transaction executes on that connection.

If AC-3 grows: assert chosen alert mechanism fires on terminal failure; update terminal_failure_records_mail_failed_skip_reason in lockstep if the label changes.
